svg.title: EffectTrace Kubernetes flow
svg.desc: Kubernetes flow for restart_workload on shop/checkout. The MCP tool span links to the Kubernetes client span by TRACE_LINK (blue). The client's PATCH deployments shop/checkout reaches Deployment shop/checkout, generation 3 to 4, by a DIRECT edge (green), verified by Audit-ID match plus UID plus resourceVersion and confirmed by the kube-apiserver audit event. STRUCTURAL edges (teal) fan out to the new ReplicaSet checkout-8554d95446 with 3 Pods created and 3/3 ready, and to the old ReplicaSet checkout-6f758776cf scaled 3 to 0 with 3 Pods terminated. EVENT_REFERENCE edges (violet) attach Kubernetes Events. A dotted TEMPORAL_CORRELATION edge (amber) attaches http_p99_latency for checkout, baseline 50ms observed 149ms, correlation only. Path grades: object and event paths are ATTRIBUTED, the latency path is CORRELATED; frontend latency is listed as excluded.
svg.text: confirmed by the kube-apiserver audit event
